generic_dependencies.src/portable_setup.py::collect_classes: Collects, sanitizes and validates intelligence-class markdown while rejecting symlink escapes; it does not inspect integration policy or refs.
generic_dependencies.src/portable_setup.py::pool_settings: Projects parsed profile inheritance, harness and pool knobs into PoolSettings; it contains no integration owner or source-admission logic.
generic_dependencies.src/portable_setup.py::portable_url: Generic repository URL sanitizer strips credentials and machine paths; integration-specific project adapters are charged independently.
generic_dependencies.src/portable_setup.py::project_settings: Projects ordinary project fields and sanitized repository URLs into portable ProjectSettings without examining integration evidence or changing Git state.

src/portable_setup.py::ProjectSettings.i.reason: Typed portable integration preference draft; carries desired mode, policy and repository identity without runtime state.

src/portable_setup.py::ProjectSettings.v.reason: Read-only validation of portable integration modes and review delegation.

src/portable_setup.py::ProjectSettings.w.reason: Read-only typed projection of desired integration mode, policy and repository identity; generic project and repository export remains separate.
